name: Zambia

fees.name: Single Entry e-Visa
fees.notes: Statutory fee $25 plus card-payment administrative fee; total shown ($50.50) is the card-payment total on the official pricing page. Mobile money payment total may be slightly lower. Applied for online via eservices.zambiaimmigration.gov.zm or on arrival.

fees.name: Double Entry Visa
fees.notes: Statutory fee $40 plus card-payment administrative fee; total shown is the card-payment total.

fees.name: Multiple Entry Visa
fees.notes: Statutory fee $75 plus card-payment administrative fee; total shown is the card-payment total. Two separate listings (single-entry $25 base and multiple-entry $75 base) both appear on the official fee schedule; card-payment totals for double and multiple entry converge at $80.80 per the pricing page.

fees.name: Transit Visa
fees.applies: all eligible nationalities requiring transit visa
fees.notes: Statutory fee $25 plus card-payment administrative fee.

fees.name: KAZA UniVisa (Zambia-Zimbabwe regional visa)
fees.applies: eligible nationalities, issued at designated ports of entry (incl. Victoria Falls, Kazungula) or online
fees.notes: Statutory fee $50 plus card-payment administrative fee. Covers multiple entries between Zambia and Zimbabwe within validity.

fees.name: Day Tripper Visa
fees.applies: day visitors at Victoria Falls and Kazungula border only
fees.notes: Statutory fee $10 plus card-payment administrative fee.

free_visa_notes: Nationals of 53 countries are visa-exempt for stays up to 90 days per 12-month period per the official Zambia Department of Immigration visitor page. The official pricing page does not publish nationality-specific fee variations (e.g. no distinct IND/USA/GBR/CHN/NGA/PAK/PHL/BGD/RUS/CAN rates were found) - all listed fees appear to be flat rates for non-exempt nationalities requiring a visa. Zambia visa applications are processed directly through the government's own e-Services portal (eservices.zambiaimmigration.gov.zm); no outsourced visa application centre (VFS/TLScontact/BLS) is used.
